stories.title: Why this 40-year market veteran is making a lonely bet on a 40% stock-market crash — and $500 oil

stories.zh_summary: 烏爾夫林達爾表示，美國股市的投資人正在醞釀一場風暴，幾年後他們也將面臨500美元的油價。這裡是他避難的地方。

stories.title: Apple’s new study looks to improve the effectiveness of AI health tools
stories.summary: Apple announced a new study today with the goal of better understanding how people interact with conversational AI health tools and how useful their responses actually are. The company is conducting the Apple Health AI Usage Study in collaboration with OpenEvidence, a clinical AI platform used by healthcare professionals that generates answers based on medical […]

stories.zh_summary: 蘋果今天宣布了一項新研究，旨在更好地了解人們如何與對話式人工智慧健康工具互動以及他們的反應實際上有多有用。該公司正在與 OpenEvidence 合作進行 Apple Health AI 使用研究，OpenEvidence 是他使用的臨床 AI 平台。

stories.title: China’s hottest stocks these days have one thing in common: names that sound like sheep
stories.summary: Shares of fish processors, lighting manufacturers and appliance makers have soared ahead of the Year of the Sheep. Investor appetite has had little to do with the status of their businesses.
